title: Sleeps 24 | 2 Units | 8 BR | 2 miles to Broadway
description:
*** PRICE INCLUDES BOTH UNITS ***

Two brand-new, super trendy, luxurious townhomes!
2 UNITS! 4 BALCONIES! 8 Bedrooms! 8 Bathrooms! The townhomes have beautiful open fully equipped kitchens. Each unit has a 2 car garage and plenty of beds. These townhomes have everything you need to make unforgettable memories in Music City!

***We have Starbucks, Publix, and Chase Bank at the Location***

The space
Bed configuration (in EACH unit) 

First-floor bedroom. (1) - 2 Queen + 1 extra foldable bed
Second-floor bedroom (2) - 2 Full
Third-floor bedroom (3) - 2 Queen + 1 extra foldable bed
Third-floor bedroom. (4) - 1 King
Living Room: 2 Queen pullout sofa beds

Each bedroom has a private bathroom.

This place has been planned thinking about you, the guest. Not one detail was overlooked. This house is straight out of a magazine!

Guest access
You'll have the entire unit for yourself. 
We have a smart keypad lock. You'll receive the access code to the unit 24 hours prior to your arrival

Other things to note
*GREAT FOR LARGE GROUPS*
The complex has 6 side by side large beautiful NEW townhomes. The complex has the capability of holding up to 72 guests. Each house has 4 bedrooms and 4 baths. We have accommodations that can fit any group size, so please inquire and we can find the best option for you!
